csv_scope_of_work: The Board of County Commissioners of Queen Anne s County, Maryland (hereafter known as the Owner) is seeking Statements of Qualifications from aviation consulting firms to provide professional planning, environmental, engineering, architectural, and construction phase services at Bay Bridge Airport (W29). The selected firm will provide the Owner with assistance in implementing airport improvement and maintenance projects over the next five (5) years. Projects may include, but are not limited to, those included in the current 5-Year Airport Capital Improvement Program (ACIP), and involve north airfield apron expansion, and additional projects which may come up within the contract period.
